initiatives.name: Jeannette Rankin Peace Center
initiatives.description: Missoula peace center founded in 1988. Runs education, dialogue and nonviolent action programs, a Fair Trade store, Indigenous arts programs, community events and the Peace Park.

initiatives.name: Food Not Bombs Missoula
initiatives.description: Local mutual aid collective sharing meals with community in need.

initiatives.name: Western Montana LGBTQ+ Community Center
initiatives.description: LGBTQ+ community center in Missoula offering drop-in space, peer support, weekly groups, and resources for Western Montana; it also hosts Missoula Pride.

initiatives.name: Western Montana Democratic Socialists of America
initiatives.description: We believe all people should run the economic and political system democratically to meet human & environmental needs.
